action.name: Push to Flowzone
action.command: sh -c 'cd %f; flowzone-bridge push-changes "$(xclip -o -selection clipboard 2>/dev/null || echo "Update")"; flowzone-notify push "Changes pushed"'
action.description: Git add, commit, and push via Flowzone bridge

action.name: Copy Git Remote URL
action.command: sh -c 'cd %f; git remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null | tr -d "\n" | xclip -selection clipboard; flowzone-notify info "Remote URL copied"'
action.description: Copy the git remote URL to clipboard

action.name: OpenCode Prompt Here
action.command: sh -c 'cd %f; opencode prompt "Review the code in this directory and suggest improvements"'
action.description: Run OpenCode prompt starting from this directory
